parameters.name: EndpointIds
parameters.description: A list of mount target IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).

parameters.name: InstanceIds
parameters.description: The ID of the acceleration instance.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the mount target. Fuzzy matching is supported.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
The sort order. Valid values:

- Desc: Sorts the results in descending order.

- Asc: Sorts the results in ascending order.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The value starts from 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: SlotIds
parameters.description: The ID of the dataset acceleration slot. For more information about how to obtain the slot ID, see [ListSlots](~~467905~~).

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description: The field to use for sorting.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The network type of the mount target. The required parameters vary based on the network type.

- VPC: The mount target is in a VPC.

- INNER: The mount target is in the PAI internal network and is used for access by other PAI products.
